scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] plans a fourteen-day trip linking several South Korean stops by rail and short flights, limits the clothing rotation by doing laundry, and deliberately leaves room for purchases while checking that the packed case remains manageable through repeated transfers.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]计划用铁路和短途航班串联韩国多个地点，共旅行十四天；通过途中洗衣减少衣物轮换数量，同时特意为购物留出空间，并检查装好的行李箱在频繁换乘中是否仍易于搬运。
examples: using Medium when a disciplined capsule and laundry leave enough shopping room
choosing Large when the same case must absorb purchases without a second carrier
rejecting Extra Large when transfer friction outweighs unused reserve volume

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] takes two children on a four-day festival loop through Japan, combining a stroller or carrier, luggage forwarding, coin laundry, and two days of clothes so the luggage that stays with the family remains manageable on trains, buses, and crowded event days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]带两个孩子在日本进行四天祭典环线旅行，会结合婴儿车或背带、行李转运、投币洗衣和仅携带两天衣物，让始终留在身边的行李仍适合火车、巴士和拥挤的活动日。
examples: using Small for one adult's tickets, water, and immediate child-care items after forwarding the main cases
using Medium when spare clothing for both children must stay accessible during the festival day
using Large only for the consolidated family load between forwarding points

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a seven-day desert trek, [X] must carry three to six litres between refill points, compares a bladder with bottles, and practises with the heaviest water interval before deciding how much pack volume remains for the rest of the kit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在七天沙漠徒步中，[X]需要在补水点之间携带三至六升水，会比较水袋与水瓶，并按最重的缺水路段负载进行试背，再判断背包还剩多少容量可用于其他装备。
examples: using Medium only when the route segment and compact kit keep the water load within it
choosing Large when the longest refill interval must coexist with food and shelter essentials
rejecting Extra Large when extra room encourages weight the hiker cannot carry comfortably

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After an international arrival, [X] compares taking two full wheeled cases on the airport train with the final one-kilometre walk to a Seoul hotel, deciding when rail storage is technically sufficient but a taxi is still the more practical last-mile choice.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 国际航班抵达后，[X]需要带着两个装满的大号拉杆箱乘机场铁路，并面对前往首尔酒店的最后一公里步行；据此判断，即使列车储物空间够用，什么时候出租车仍是更实际的最后一程方案。
examples: using Large when one wheeled case can still be managed through the station and hotel walk
using Extra Large when the two-case load requires vehicle-based last-mile transport
treating Medium as the upper target for a future trip meant to stay rail-and-walk friendly

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] lives in Portugal, saves from a monthly salary, and plans a three-day break in Paris, comparing the included under-seat allowance with a paid cabin case to decide whether a tighter packing list is worth avoiding the extra fare.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]住在葡萄牙，平时从月薪中储蓄，并计划去巴黎短住三天；在机票自带的座位下行李额度与需要付费的登机箱之间比较，判断为了省下附加费而压缩行李清单是否值得。
examples: using Small when the included personal item can hold the three-day essentials
choosing Medium when a little more clothing flexibility justifies a cabin allowance
rejecting Large when the added airline fee and handling do not serve such a short trip

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] tests one work backpack with a 15-inch laptop, notebooks, water bottle, chargers, and pens, checking whether the organized load fits without wasted bulk or overloaded straps before allowing room for an occasional change of clothes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]用一只工作背包装入 15 英寸笔记本电脑、笔记本、水瓶、充电器和笔，检查这些物品能否有序装下而不造成多余体积或肩带超负荷，再考虑是否还要为偶尔携带的替换衣物留出空间。
examples: using Small only when the laptop and minimal accessories fit without crowding
choosing Medium for the normal laptop, notebook, bottle, and charger load
moving to Large when a regular clothing layer or lunch must join the work kit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] wants to bring cooked pasta for a workday lunch and, after ruling out an unsafe overnight room-temperature container, switches to an insulated daily kit that can hold the sealed meal, ice packs, fruit or snacks, and any shelf-stable backup needed before the break.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]想把煮好的意面带作工作日午餐，在确认食物不能装盒后放在室温中过夜后，改用能容纳密封餐盒、冰袋、水果或零食，以及午休前可能需要的常温备用食物的保温日用包。
examples: using Small when the chilled meal and one ice pack are the only carried food
choosing Medium when fruit, snacks, and a drink must remain with the lunch container
rejecting Large when unused air and bulk make the everyday work carry harder without improving food safety

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before attending a stadium concert, [X] checks the venue's clear-bag limit and pares the carry down to a phone, identification, payment card, compact power bank, earplugs, sanitizer, and only the weather items permitted by the rules.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在参加体育场演唱会前，[X]先核对场馆的透明包尺寸限制，把携带物精简为手机、证件、支付卡、小型充电宝、耳塞、消毒用品，以及规则允许的少量天气防护物品。
examples: using Small when the approved clear bag holds the permitted essentials
going without a bag when secure clothing pockets cover the minimal load
rejecting Medium, Large, or Extra Large when the venue will refuse them at entry

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While budgeting a birthday party for a two-year-old child, [X] assembles the same practical favor set for each young guest and checks whether bubbles, stickers, crayons, a fruit snack, and a miniature coloring item fit neatly enough to prepare eight, twelve, or sixteen units without costly filler.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为两岁孩子的生日会做预算时，[X]为每位小客人准备相同的实用伴手礼包，并检查泡泡、贴纸、蜡笔、水果零食和迷你涂色用品能否紧凑装下，以便制作八份、十二份或十六份，而无需购买昂贵的填充物。
examples: using Small for the fixed five-item toddler favor set
rejecting Medium when extra space would require filler or encourage unnecessary purchases
keeping every unit the same capacity so the batch remains fair and easy to distribute

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a full day in Akihabara, [X] carries a passport, cash or transit card, and a navigation device while accumulating sealed tax-free gadgets and souvenirs, then uses a station locker or hotel drop once the purchases outgrow a crowd-friendly day load.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在秋叶原逛一整天时，[X]随身携带护照、现金或交通卡和导航设备，同时逐渐买入密封的免税电子产品与纪念品；当购物所得超过适合在人群中携带的日用容量后，便改用车站储物柜或先送回酒店。
examples: using Small when the day is mainly browsing and only essentials stay on body
choosing Medium when several planned gadgets and souvenirs must remain hands-free between stores
rejecting Large in dense multistorey shops when a locker or hotel drop can absorb bulky purchases
